modules.module_title: Manage preparatory activities for BOF operation

pcs.pc_description: obtain the required information and work completed in previous shift from logbook, discussions etc. and take handover from the previous shift operator by following organizational procedures

ensure availability of sufficient quantity of material (hot metal, lime, dololime, scrap, iron ore or any other material), machinery, consumables and tools required for smooth running of the operation and achieving production target
ensure that work area is clean and free of any obstacle or encumbrance
check the condition of BOF convertor, movement of top lance, functioning of bottom plugs, oxygen and argon pressure, lance cooling system etc. as per SOP before starting the operation of new heat
ensure that all safety measures, interlocks, alarms are working and in conformance with the safe operation of BOF converter
check the BOF gas holder for the availability of space for storing BOF gas in it

coordinate with other departments such as oxygen plant for oxygen, gas distribution network for argon gas, blast furnace for hot metal etc. for arranging the production requirements and smooth operation of BOF process
ensure that team is checking the temperature and quantity of hot metal received from blast furnace / Corex for BOF operation
monitor that sampler is taking the sample of hot metal and other materials and sending it to lab for quality and chemical composition analysis by following organizational procedure
analyse the observations of quality check and chemical composition analysis report and set the process parameters of BOF in accordance with it
use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for safe working in work area
feed the hot metal, solid charge (i.e. scrap, iron ore or any other material) and flux (lime and dololime) in the BOF converter as per SOP/WI
ensure that appropriate quantity of solid charge and flux is added with hot metal in the BOF converter as per SOP
calculate the oxygen requirement and time of blow on the basis of quantity of hot metal for blowing operation
adjust the lance height and start oxygen blow at predetermined flow rate and pressure
operate the BOF converter and perform blowing operation by following SOP/WI
take the sample of liquid steel, measure the temperature of bath and send the sample for chemical composition analysis to lab by following organizational procedures
analyse the chemical composition and if required, decide re-blowing operation again till the required composition is achieved
calculate the amount of oxygen to be reblown; if required, based on the sample analysis and temperature of bath
check that ladle is cleaned and appropriate temperature of ladle is maintained as per SOP
check that ladle is placed in tapping pit before starting the tapping of liquid steel

perform tapping operation to tap the liquid steel in the ladle through tap hole after getting the required composition of the steel and temperature as per the ladle condition and add ferroalloys and other additives as per SOP
perform slagging operation to collect the slag in the slag pot after completion of tapping operation
inspect the BOF converter for any damage to the refractory lining, perform slag coating on refractory before taking the charge for the next heat
update and maintain shift log of production and prepare production and other reports
record all instructions received from higher authorities in the instruction book and all incidents in the occurrence book
inform concerned authority in case of any abnormalities observed during execution of work
